table_title: List Summer Olympics host city, host country, continent, and number of participating nations from 1970 through 1990.
db_analog: SELECT year, host_city, host_country, continent, participating_nations FROM summer_olympic_games WHERE year BETWEEN 1960 AND 2020 ORDER BY year
temporal_note: Wikipedia per-edition Summer Olympics articles accessed 2026-04-30. The temporal filter (year BETWEEN 1960 AND 2020) yields 16 Summer Olympic Games editions held every four years. Tokyo 2020 was held in 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic but retains its 'Tokyo 2020' official IOC designation; the staged Year column uses 2020 (the IOC-official designation) per the master Wikipedia article's convention. Host country names use the politically-current name at the time of the Games: 'West Germany' for the 1972 Munich Games (Germany was politically divided 1949-1990); 'Soviet Union' for the 1980 Moscow Games (USSR existed 1922-1991). All facts are stable historical records and will not drift over time.
_extraction_notes: Derived from summer_olympics_hosts_1960_2020 by deterministic filter/projection on the parent CSV. Year-range slice 1970 <= Year <= 1990.
